reason: The current model scores 0.470 macro validation HR@10 versus the baseline's 0.505, with Electronics at 0.305 versus 0.420; this motivates testing candidate embedding magnitude without establishing normalization as the cause. Modify model_design to isolate that hypothesis and training_evaluation to guarantee matching generated inference. Historical experiments support retaining the causal encoder and caution against introducing another objective change or separating the tied embeddings.

plan.model_design: In HistoryModel.score(self, context, candidates), replace items = F.normalize(self.output_emb(candidates), dim=-1) with items = self.output_emb(candidates), retaining all existing variable names and method signatures. Keep the normalized context returned by encode, the existing learned scale clamped between 1 and 40, and the jointly trained additive item_bias exactly unchanged, so candidate norms can express context-dependent relevance strength. Preserve self.output_emb = self.input_emb, embedding initialization, the causal backbone, pooling, dimensions, dropout, and every other architectural setting; historical failures of embedding separation and objective replacement favor isolating this scoring change. Retain the existing 64-negative sampled-softmax objective, exclusion masks, optimizer, learning-rate policy, gradient clipping, and prefix sampling, without introducing norm penalties, alternative scoring components, or additional fitted models.
plan.training_evaluation: Preserve write_predictor(), train_category(name, device, deadline), and predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None); ensure the generated working/predict.py continues importing the modified HistoryModel and calling its shared predict/score path, with no candidate normalization added in inference. Extend the existing selected-checkpoint verification to compare scores against the explicit raw-embedding dot product plus the unchanged learned scale and item bias, while retaining strict checkpoint loading, tied-parameter assertions, and generated-predictor parity checks without additional training runs. Keep batching, EPOCHS with SASREC_EPOCHS default 200, deadlines, validation frequency, early stopping, checkpoint selection, supplied splits, preprocessing seed 0, and training/evaluation seeds 42 unchanged. Train from scratch and deploy exactly one selected checkpoint per category, retaining all four routes, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, and single-GPU execution, with no ensembles, averaging, other-trial checkpoint reuse, extra data, hidden-test access, or host-evaluator changes. Assess actual pinned-host macro validation HR@10 using 200 users per category and 99 unique negatives, comparing against 0.470 and Electronics 0.305; recovery toward baseline 0.505 remains a hypothesis.
